subject: Lighthouse - purchase path check-in: PO vs card, signatory & budget owner
messages:
From: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.ai>
To: Sophie Barnes <sophie@lighthouse.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 11 Apr 2026 15:10:00 -0700
Subject: Lighthouse - purchase path check-in: PO vs card, signatory & budget owner

Hi Sophie — thanks again for a productive call today. Quick recap and a few asks so we can align on procurement readiness and next steps: 

1) Current commercial path: you mentioned Finance prefers PO for annual contracts but some teams use corporate card for first pilot. Can you confirm whether the trial (3-month pilot) would be expected to go on card, or we should prepare a PO routing for your procurement team?

2) Budget owner + economic buyer: you said the ML platform team owns tech evaluation, while the business analytics org is owning budget. Can you share the preferred budget owner name/email and whether the finance sponsor will be Kate Monroe (as discussed)?

3) Signatory & approvals: who signs for $50k+ subscriptions internally? Is it an ELT member or delegated to procurement? Any required legal review cadence we should expect?

4) Marketplace interest: you flagged the AWS marketplace as a potential procurement route. Is the marketplace mandatory to enable for procurement, or just a preference?

Attachments: I’m including a short SOW draft and a pricing summary so procurement has numbers to evaluate.

Proposed next steps: if you can reply with the budget owner and approval route by EOD Tue, we’ll prepare a PO-facing quote + SOW and loop in Contracts. If card is the preferred route for pilot, we’ll issue a card-invoice option and stripe link instead.

Thanks — Camila
Camila Reyes
Senior AE, Redwood Inference
camila@redwood.ai
Redwood Inference

----
Attachment stubs: RI_SOW_v1_lighthouse.pdf (SOW draft), pricing_summary_Q2_2026.xlsx (price bands)
From: Sophie Barnes <sophie@lighthouse.ai>
To: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@lighthouse.ai>, Procurement Team <procurement@lighthouse.ai>
Date: Mon, 13 Apr 2026 09:02:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Lighthouse - purchase path check-in: PO vs card, signatory & budget owner

Thanks Camila — nice summary. A few quick answers from our side: 

- Pilot payment: prefers to use corporate card for the 3-month pilot (low friction) — procurement comfortable with card for pilots under $10k.
- Post-pilot/annual: Finance will require a PO for contracts >$25k per year. So for the annual plan we should expect a PO.
- Budget owner: confirmed as Jordan Lee (jordan.lee@lighthouse.ai) — he’s the analytics director and will own the budget approval.
- Finance sponsor: Kate Monroe (kate.monroe@lighthouse.ai) will be the finance sponsor for this purchase; she may want a short call with pricing.
- Signatory: for amounts between $25k–$100k procurement can sign under delegated authority, >$100k ELT sign-off required.
- Marketplace: marketplace is preferred for cataloging but not required; procurement will take whatever route gives the cleanest spend tracking.

I’m CCing Procurement and Jordan to make intros. We’ll need the SOW + a PO-ready quote to kick off the PO path after pilot.

Regards,
Sophie
Head of ML Ops, Lighthouse Analytics

----
Inline from Sophie: Jordan and Procurement — Camila will share the PO-facing docs; are you available for a 20–30m sync Wed afternoon?
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
To: Sophie Barnes <sophie@lighthouse.ai>, Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.ai>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 13 Apr 2026 11:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Lighthouse - purchase path check-in: PO vs card, signatory & budget owner

Hi Sophie — thanks for the clarity. Taking next steps from Redwood ops side: 

- Attached: PO-ready quote (pricing_summary_Q2_2026.xlsx) and a concise SOW (RI_SOW_v1_lighthouse.pdf). The quote includes two options: Pilot (card invoice, 3 months, $8,400) and Annual (PO, 12 months, $62,400) with an annual commit discount.
- Marketplace: we can publish to AWS Marketplace but that process takes ~3–4 weeks for onboarding. If procurement needs quicker procurement tracking via marketplace, we can prioritize but it will delay start date.
- Signatory: if you need a PO workflow we can accept Lighthouse PO and route to our contracts team. For delegated procurement sign-off (25k–100k) we accept procurement-signed PO — legal review only required for custom SLAs or data terms.

Suggested MA Plan: 
- Wed 14 Apr: 20m sync (Jordan + Kate + Camila) to confirm budget and review SOW
- Thu 15 Apr: if pilot on card, we issue card invoice and start within 48 hours
- If PO path chosen, Procurement issues PO by Mon 19 Apr; Redwood issues PO invoice and schedules kickoff the week of Apr 26

Attaching the files here for procurement review. Happy to jump on a quick call with Kate for the finance questions.

Best,
Ben Carter
Senior Sales Ops, Redwood Inference

----
Attachments: pricing_summary_Q2_2026.xlsx, RI_SOW_v1_lighthouse.pdf
From: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.ai>
To: Sophie Barnes <sophie@lighthouse.ai>, Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@lighthouse.ai>, Procurement Team <procurement@lighthouse.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 13 Apr 2026 09:37:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Lighthouse - purchase path check-in: PO vs card, signatory & budget owner

Thanks everyone — wrapping this up into a single action list: 

- Jordan: can you confirm by EOD Wed whether pilot will be charged to team card (we’ll send invoice link) or you prefer to issue a PO for the pilot?
- Kate (Finance): Ben, can we set a 15-minute intro to go over the annual pricing bands and whether any extra documentation is required for the PO? (Ben — please propose 2 times Wed/Thu).
- Procurement: please review attached SOW + PO-ready quote. If you want marketplace procurement, flag that now so we can start onboarding (adds ~3–4 weeks).

If I don’t hear otherwise, we’ll plan to issue the card-invoice for the pilot and prepare a PO-facing contract concurrently so Lighthouse can transition to PO for annual renewal. 

Thanks — Camila

----
Thread metadata: mutual action plan proposed; requested confirmations from Jordan and Kate; attachments included for procurement review.
